title: Quality of Life, Recombinant TSH (Thyrogen) and Thyroid Cancer
brief_summary: To evaluate quality of life in patients after 10 days pause of thyroid medication (Liothyronine) compared to treatment with recombinant TSH (Thyrogen) before radioiodine uptake and treatment in a double-blinded, randomised cross-over design.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Follicular or papillary thyroid cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< 18 or \> 75 years old
* Pregnant or lactating women
